notes.title: An Update on Development
notes.content:
Greetings, sinners.

It's been a while, hasn't it? Rest assured, a new update is in the works.

Update 1.4: SISTER O SISTER- A full OVERHAUL of the Ante-Purgatory levels, including a brand new 0-7 and 0-B- Improvements to ALL Overture/Movement 1 levels- A COMPLETE revamp of all Eternity weapons- High-tier enemies gain access to HEAT BREAKERS, intense super-attacks that give HP, Judgement, and Heat should you perform well- New music- A brand new first boss in 0-3- And finally...

2-1: The World
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44093350/3ad576bc97c3d231af5abc71af58d685172e56c6.jpg"]
Though there is currently no ETA for 1.4, I can promise it will be soon.

In other news, a great amount of progress has been made on Movement 2. Alongside 2-1, 2-2 is also completely finished, with 2-3 and 2-A soon to follow.

Without Wax,Team Myster

notes.title: Update 1.3: GOD APPEARS AND GOD IS LIGHT
notes.content:
Greetings, sinners.

The Sefirot no longer emanates light, and now contracts towards a point of Singularity.

Will you be able to bear the burden of Infinity?


Primary Changes:

 Added 1-6 through 1-10
 Added 3 secret levels, 1-A, 1-B, and 1-C, to Movement 1: Sefirot
 Added Movement 1 Requiems
 Added Floors 151-200 to the Aeon



Other Changes:

 Fixed title display stuff
 Credited Jameshrooms for conceptualizing Baal
 Rearranged Codex order
 Added an Interlude for Overture Requiems
 Reduced Armageddon's projectile output
 Reduced lag caused by Armageddon
 Made the explosion created by Aura larger
 Fixed an issue with damage calculations while restoring stamina with Eternity weapons
 Removed achievements for defeating the Cardinal Virtues in 0-4 and the Theological Virtues in 0-9
 Significantly reduced lag created by Muses
 Credited my wacky workout partner for the voicelines he recorded in place of another character whose VA got sick (The character in question will get their normal voice back eventually, don't worry)
 Renamed old updates to give them cooler names


C: EAS will be 50% off until March 1st to celebrate the update. Please note that, after that period, the game's price will permanently increase. Now is the chance to buy if you're interested; this is the cheapest it will ever be.

Without Wax,
Team Myster

notes.title: Update 1.2: KILL THE PARASITE
notes.content:
Greetings, sinners.

Throughout the Spire, the Isles, and the Tower, secrets have begun to unveil themselves.

Relive your memories, and delve deeper into what truly lies behind the Angelic invasion.


Primary Changes:

 Added 3 secret levels, 0-A, 0-B, and 0-C, to Overture: Purgatory
 Heavily rebalanced various enemies
 Remade 0-1 and 0-2 (It is heavily advised to replay these before playing new content)



Other Changes:

 Slightly buffed Sinistras
 Removed aliasing from Dextera and Sinistra renders
 Removed unnecessary text from 1-3
 Fixed issues with 0-6 challenges
 Fixed Cascade render
 Made Armageddon RAY less RNG dependent
 Fixed issues with loading a checkpoint in 1-1
 Reduced Pudicitia homing bullet output
 Emanation (Reprise) has been removed
 Dead God’s Lullaby now plays during the first encounter of the second half of 1-3, which then switches back to Emanation for the rest of the level
 1-4 now plays Emanation
 Enemy barriers no longer scale with difficulty
 Reworked the 1-4 secret boss
 Hourglass now consumes HP instead of Stamina
 Updated the demo


Without Wax,
Team Myster

notes.title: Update 1.1: ALL HEAVEN IN A RAGE
notes.content:
Greetings, sinners.

You've had your fun with RAY, but now... The time has come.

Advance through the glorious Sefirot, and continue your journey to the Sinner's Paradise.


Primary Changes:

 Added 1-2 through 1-5
 Added a new secret boss to 0-7
 Added Floors 101-150 to the Aeon



Other Changes:

 Scion-based enemies (Scion, Sapientia, Iustitia, Temperantia, Fortitudo, Pudicitia, Spes, Caritas, Fides) can no longer become Invulnerable by closing their shells, instead taking reduced damage by doing so
 Updated Eden’s hand model
 Fixed issues with Eden’s AI
 Fixed a really big mistake in Eden’s Codex entry
 Fixed issues with the Rage Passive
 Probably fixed an issue with checkpoints causing a softlock
 Fixed various issues with Challenges displaying on Title
 Fixed various issues with tooltips
 Touching water no longer teleports you up, now applying an upward force
 Made various enemy icons bigger
 Changed Floor 90 of the Aeon
 Fixed issues with improper Passive display
 Doubled the length of Hope’s beams
 Doubled the duration of IFrames from taking damage
 Removed the ability to equip two of the same Passive (Sorry, double Executioner builds)
 Renamed Chapter 3 and Chapter 4
 Fixed issues with 0-10R
 Recolored Fides’ beams
 Added the ability to see your full clear history for a level to the level select and equip screens (Ranks prior to this update cannot be viewed)
 Player barriers now grant iFrames when destroyed
 Changed the color of the One God’s name in 0-10 to orange
 Enemy health bars now display how close a Barrier is to breaking
 Fixed that one corner in 0-1 after 2 and a half years
 Kinda fixed an issue where the top of boss health bars were cut off on certain resolutions by just decreasing the size of them (Every other UI element properly scales to screen size, I have no idea why these are so finicky)
 Added an outro to 0-5’s music
 0-5R now requires you to kill all enemies instead of just Eden
 Heat multipliers now slowly recover over time (Ex. You hit a target with Strife, Strife’s Heat multiplier for that enemy goes down to, say, 0.5, even if you don’t damage that enemy with another weapon, Strife’s multiplier will slowly recover up to 2.0; It takes ~27 seconds for a multiplier to regenerate from the minimum of 0.33 to the maximum of 2.0 if the enemy is not damaged by anything else)
 Enemies no longer initialize on the same frame, each initializes on a separate frame
 Fixed water in older levels


Without Wax,
Team Myster
